text:
Recently, my teeth were drilled and orthodontic anchors were placed without prior notification. I only found out after the procedure had begun, once the anesthetic was applied, while I was in the treatment chair, and while I was lying down with my mouth open, unable to speak.

During the procedure, the anchors were also placed incorrectly, requiring removal and re-placing, causing unnecessary pain. Furthermore, just two days later, the anchors fell out again, even though I could barely eat anything, only porridge, and hardly used my teeth to chew at all.

I would like to urge the clinic management to review their communication standards before procedures, the explanation of treatment plans, and the quality of post-procedure care. Please also reconsider the dentist handling this case. I felt unsafe and my time wasted significantly.

I hope to receive a follow-up call and see serious improvements.
